descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S22 Other delete controls (previous note, lab value, diagnostic finding, Quick Dictation compartment) ask once, and repeated delete controls name the item they delete

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Every delete asks for confirmation exactly once, in both modes: a medication row, a task (Encounter or Post-Round), an Important Point, and the other one-tap delete controls on the charts — a previou … (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 6; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Hospital patient seeded with two Important Points, one previous note and a Quick Dictation compartment; Nursing Home resident seeded with two Important Points, one previous note, one lab value and two diagnostic findings

When For each of the other delete controls: tap it once, press Cancel if a confirmation appears, save a checkpoint. On screens with several delete controls of one kind, read their accessible names.

Then Every delete control asks once and Cancel keeps the item (U8, scope Q4). Delete controls in one list have names that say which item they delete (WCAG 2.4.6 / 4.1.2), not several buttons all named 'Delete point' or 'Remove finding'.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U8 (UAT TC-24 'Each delete asks for confirmation once', TFA-94699 AC 6), scope Q4. oracle.mjs: after the first tap and Cancel the item is still there. Names: mustNotContain the generic name exactly, closing quote included ('button "Delete point"', 'button "Remove finding"'), on screens that list two of them; per-item names such as 'Delete task: <text>' pass. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
